label: Scenario-based operational carbon estimate
powerSource: A hypothetical constant 10 W compute allocation for the duration of each measured request batch. Chosen for arithmetic demonstration, not a hardware power measurement, TDP, or empirically calibrated application allocation.
factorSource: A hypothetical 400 gCO2e/kWh electricity supply. Not a regional, Airbus, or current grid factor.
boundary: Hypothetical operational compute allocation during the warmed target-process request-batch interval only
exclusions: Startup and cache-loading energy, warm-up, idle time outside the batch, load-generator energy
Storage and network energy, cooling/PUE, embodied hardware emissions and the rest of the software lifecycle
formulaNote: Uses E times I per functional unit for the operational component only. Energy here is an illustrative power-times-duration allocation; this is not a complete SCI assessment.
